verdict.rationale: Unreal documents first-party, editor-integrated version control for Perforce and SVN, so teams can share assets and code with history and rollback. It also offers Multi-User Editing, where multiple editor instances work together in one live shared session. That satisfies the story's built-in-collaboration path, though Multi-User Editing is marked Beta. missing for 10: evidence of diffable text-based project/scene formats or mergeable levels/assets, non-Beta status for Multi-User Editing, independent or hands-on corroboration of team workflows.
